direction: Original sturdy classic-era worn russet fox mascot, plain dark-green dealer vest, one faded original spade token patch, tired glass eyes, repaired heavy tail and hand-parented small four-card fan.

construction.geometry: Original Blender procedural authored mesh, named editable source pieces retained.
construction.atlas: Original 1024x1024 indexed PNG; deterministic tactile pigment using NumPy seed 10201.
construction.skin: One skin, 25 bones, two material primitives. Maximum two nonzero skin weights, only flexible tail uses blending.
construction.coordinates: Blender Z-up/+Y forward; glTF Y-up/-Z forward. Identity scene root at floor; no animated scene root.
construction.export: Blender glTF 2.0 GLB; NLA_TRACKS; 60 Hz sampled ordinary bone transforms; no required extension/decoder; embedded texture; no runtime IK.

clip_semantics.idle: Loop, 2.8 seconds; small still mechanical head/ear/card motions.
clip_semantics.move: Loop, 1.4 seconds; stationary local shuffle with level padded feet.
clip_semantics.attack: Once, 2.0 seconds; fan lifted and held 0.85–1.08 seconds, outward forward snap at 1.25 seconds, fraction 0.625.
clip_semantics.defeat: Once, 2.4 seconds; comic tail/card-droop slump held from 1.766667 seconds. No authored fade, hiding, or root scaling.

runtime_scope: Studio only. No level or gameplay encounter mapping changed. Tom exact-art review and later eligibility/device/gameplay gates remain open.
reference_license_note: Uses project-generated selected concept direction and original authored geometry/texture. Source concept terms stay with the existing versioned source record.
